items.title: O'Reilly’s (NASDAQ:ORLY) Q2 CY2026: Beats On Revenue
items.summary: Auto parts and accessories retailer O’Reilly Automotive (NASDAQ:ORLY) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 8.1% year on year to $4.89 billion.
